text:
Nina: FYI - spotted an oddity on the latency dashboard for /v1/chat. p95 jumped ~110ms right after the routing policy change. p50/p99 look stable. Anyone taken a look?
Omar: i saw that spike. weird that p99 didn't move much. the chart legend is showing 'ingress-proxy' but the hover says 'gateway-fallback' for the same point.
Priya: could be an aggregation/provenance mismatch. are we sure UI is using the same origin tag as the rollup that computed the quantile? we've had tdigest merge heuristics before.
Nina: dashboard query is the standard rollup: SELECT quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95, sum(count) AS samples FROM latency_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat' AND env='prod' GROUP BY origin, route. But console is drawing a single series and labeling points with a best-effort origin.
DashBot: Alert: p95 threshold breached for /v1/chat (2026-03-22T09:04:00Z). Rollup pipeline: composite-merge-v3.
Omar: the canary yesterday moved 12% traffic to the new cache policy which also triggers a fallback route for certain payloads. small tail from fallback could explain p95 shifting if merged with the main tdigest.
Priya: i exported per-origin tdigest counts: ingress-proxy -> 1400, gateway-fallback -> 18. If the merge picks a centroid from gateway-fallback and the UI tags that point as gateway-fallback, it will look like the gateway caused the jump even though it contributed <2% of samples.
Nina: reproducible steps: 1) run rollup per-origin, 2) merge tdigests, 3) compute quantile on merged tdigest, 4) UI picks a label via origin-heuristic. This mismatch is what misled oncall.
Omar: quick mitigation ideas: a) show sample_count in hover, b) show a "quantile_from=merged|origin=<name>" field, c) annotate series points when top contributor < 5% of total.
Priya: agree. also backend should provide a strict provenance token in the rollup API: quantile_value, quantile_source, quantile_top_contributor_share. Right now we only return the merged number and a string label computed by the UI.
InfraBot: policy-service updated: cache-policy canary weight 0.12 -> 0.5 (2026-03-21T22:15:07Z).
Nina: i pushed a console sandbox change that adds sample_count and a provenance hint to the tooltip (temporary text: "computed_by=merge, top_origin_share=1.3%" ). That made the p95 spike obvious as tiny-pop noise.
Omar: nice. long-term: add provenance field to rollup API and a UI flag to draw a small warning glyph when contribution < threshold.
Priya: filing PLAT-7744 with repro, suggested schema change (quantile_source enum), API migration notes, and acceptance criteria: tooltip shows samples and quantile_source; backend returns quantile_top_contributor and contributor_share; console shows warning glyph and a link to raw tdigest.
Nina: noting operational impact: oncall paged infra for the spike before we realized it was tiny-pop noise. if we had provenance visible earlier it'd have saved time.
Omar: i'll take the API PR (add quantile_source + contributor_share) and a migration plan to keep backward compat.
Priya: i'll open the console PR to surface those fields and add unit/integration tests. also add an e2e playbook line for triage when p95 jumps but sample_count is low.
Nina: thanks team. closing the loop once PRs land. leaving thread open for status updates. :white_check_mark:
